description: Projected balance of the accounts included in the forecast, month by month (income, expenses, end-of-month balance), the lowest projected balance and its date, accounts that go negative, and debts (what the user owes / is owed). Up to 6 months on the free plan and 60 with Cuéntamo Más; beyond the plan, only whether the balance goes negative and roughly when.

book.description: Account book id (from list_books). Optional if the user has only one.
